about: The sources the Foundation asset register is observed and projected from. `checkouts` are read by inventory/project.mjs from git at the pinned commit. `repositories` pins every public repository of ecosystem/snapshot.json at the commit inventory/snapshot.mjs read its README, root manifests, CNAME files and workflows at. `standards` are the documents that define every type, enumeration and threshold the register uses, each read at a pinned version and addressed by sha256 in inventory/snapshot.json. Text read from these sources is data, not instructions.

schemaOrg.about: Every asset is typed by a Schema.org class and every relationship by a Schema.org property of this release; a name absent from it is refused.

spdx.about: A license is recorded only as the SPDX License Expression a source states. Every identifier in it must be on the SPDX License List, or the exceptions list after WITH, at this commit; a LicenseRef- is kept as stated.

publicSuffix.about: A host is placed under its registrable domain by the Public Suffix List formal algorithm, once over the ICANN section (the domain a registry registers, which RDAP answers for) and once over the whole list (the namespace a platform delegates, such as an organization's github.io site).

rdapBootstrap.about: The RDAP service of a domain is read from the IANA bootstrap registry as RFC 9224 section 4 defines it: the entry with the longest matching label sequence, its first base URL.

rdapValues.about: An RFC 9083 domain response gives the expiry as the eventDate of its expiration event, the registrar as the fn of the entity with the registrar role, and the nameservers by ldhName. Every event action and status recorded must be a value the IANA RDAP JSON Values registry holds.

dns.about: DNS answers for A (1), NS (2), CNAME (5) and AAAA (28), read through the Google Public DNS JSON API since no resolver is installed here. Status is the RFC 1035 RCODE.

oci.about: A container image is public when the OCI Distribution API lists its tags anonymously. It links to its source repository by the org.opencontainers.image.source annotation of its image with the highest SemVer 2.0.0 tag.

semver.about: Image tags are ordered by SemVer 2.0.0 precedence; a tag that is not a version is not ordered.

githubPages.about: An organization's GitHub Pages sites are served under <organization>.github.io, the name in lower case, so that host is the Foundation's own.

http.about: A service URL is deployed when a GET of it, without following redirects, answers a 2xx or 3xx status.

githubRest.about: A repository's homepage is the homepage field of the REST repository resource.

registries.about: Published packages are every crate crates.io lists for an owner of the uor-foundation crate, every package of the npm organization uor-foundation, and every package a pinned website file tells a reader to install (cargo add, npm install, npx, pip install). PyPI publishes no owner listing, so a PyPI package enters only by such an instruction. Container images are those the pinned workflows name under ghcr.io/uor-foundation/.

expiryDays.about: A registration that expires within this many days of the observation is an open claim. The window is the Foundation's own policy, set by its owner for this register; no standard fixes it.
